dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, irregular scalloped perimeters. The most central 'O' shape on the dorsal ridge shows a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior to a mottled light-grey interior. A secondary smaller, discrete 'O' shape to its right features a similarly jagged, high-intensity light boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid high-intensity pixel clusters are primarily localized as components of the annuli perimeters. A small concentration of solid, asymmetrical low-gradient light-intensity blobs is visible on the lower-right lateral flank, distal to the main dorsal pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' shaped annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form an obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of five smaller annuli on the posterior-right creates a distinct pentagonal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper dorsal region displays a nested topology where multiple light-pixel perimeters overlap, creating a complex, tessellated 'cloud' effect rather than isolated discrete markings.
